$comment: Merge the 'permissions' and 'enabledPlugins' blocks below into your project's
Architecture note — two layers, one purpose:
Floor  : the 'permissions' block below.  Enforced by the Claude Code platform
before any hook runs.  Cannot be bypassed by the agent.
Defence: the pre-read hook in hooks/pre-read.  Catches edge cases the
permission patterns do not cover and adds richer diagnostic reasons.
In a managed-settings deployment the platform layer is the hard guarantee;
the hook is defence in depth.  In a project-only deployment the hook is the
only enforcement layer, so the permissions block below MUST be present.
On omp (Oh My Pi) the platform-level 'permissions' floor does not exist — omp
has no hooks/hooks.json surface.  The extension adapter (extensions/omp.mjs) is
the only enforcement layer there, which makes installing it non-optional rather
than defence in depth.  The permissions block below has no effect on omp.
$comment_ext: Project extensions: .slopguard/** (mapping overrides and tool descriptors) should be committed to the repository and reviewed like any other quality gate — these files control which binaries the guard executes and which rule severities are overridden. All writes to .slopguard/** require human approval (pre-write asks, same as .slopguard.json).
$comment_stop_gate: The Stop gate (Etap 4) runs slow checks at turn end and keeps Claude working until blockers are resolved. It is controlled by the 'stop_gate' plugin option (default: true) set when the user installs or configures the plugin — not by this settings.json. Teams with strict enforcement can also set {"stop_gate": true, "enforcement_mode": "strict"} in their .slopguard.json project file. The Stop gate itself never produces more than 2 consecutive blocks of the same finding (Z8 loop protection); after the cap it degrades to a systemMessage warning.

mcpServers.$comment: The plugin does not install the Context7 MCP server itself — it cannot guarantee its presence and will degrade silently when it is absent. Add this block to your .claude/settings.json or managed settings to enable framework-documentation lookups (§7.6 of the spec). Remove --api-key and its value if you do not have a Context7 account; basic usage is free.
